questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. The road splits, so you must turn either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On a roadway with two or more lanes, make room for entering vehicles. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are heading the wrong way on a one-way street. You risk a head-on collision. Carefully turn around and go back.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers can use it, depending on what the sign shows.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers to watch for bicycles crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm up, then swings the arm upward to signal riders to speed up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will not continue on the freeway. If you stay in this lane, you must exit. To continue on the freeway, change lanes before this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It is white and rectangular with black markings. Drivers must obey all regulatory signs. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on the road ahead. Be alert and prepared to see them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It alerts you that the road curves ahead. Slow down to safely navigate the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
Operators may turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you can either turn right or go straight. You cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign means you must stay on the side shown by the arrow. A traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead, and you must pass on the right side of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road is one-way. You cannot enter from this direction. Do not go forward.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: The road curves right first, then curves left. Slow down so you can safely handle both curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: This orange sign warns of construction or maintenance work ahead. Slow down and drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a traffic light is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light and watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a side road is ahead. Watch for traffic entering from that side road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will curve sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When your left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it signals that you plan to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when wet, making it harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming and you should prepare to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When your left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing downward, it signals that you plan to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign alerts you to an intersection ahead.
